brand_identity.tone: Refined, architectural, premium, structured, warm, highly legible

surfaces_and_borders.shadows: restrained (shadow-sm, shadow-md max, no harsh blur, 1px solid subtle borders mandatory)

component_styles.button_secondary: bg-[#F3E0DC] hover:bg-[#D4A59A] text-[#5C2018] font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors duration-200

component_styles.category_pill_active: bg-[#5C2018] text-white font-medium px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm
component_styles.category_pill_inactive: bg-white text-[#5C2018] border border-[#EADCD8] hover:border-[#BC4639] px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm transition-colors

component_styles.table: w-full text-left border-collapse bg-white rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-[#EADCD8]
component_styles.chart: Recharts line/bar chart using #BC4639 primary stroke/fill, #5C2018 secondary, #D4A59A grid, tooltip background #FFFFFF with #5C2018 border

layout_modules.storefront: Announcement bar (#5C2018 bg), sticky navbar w/ search, theme toggle, wishlist & cart triggers; 2-col hero w/ framed template previews; category pills filter; 'Most wanted this week' 3 featured cards grid; product catalog grid; 4-column earthy footer with newsletter sign-up
layout_modules.admin_portal: /admin path: sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Templates, Orders, Analytics, Settings); KPI summary cards; sales/revenue trend chart; top template performance table; recent order list; template upload & editor drawer
layout_modules.customer_portal: /account path: customer sidebar; welcome header w/ architectural photography overlay; quick stats cards; library downloads; orders history; invoices download; saved wishlist; account settings
layout_modules.cart_and_checkout: Cart item list w/ quantity adjust & price breakdown in INR (₹); 3-step checkout flow (Contact Info -> Address -> Payment with Razorpay modal trigger using #4285F4 accent pay button)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, selects, modals, tabs, table rows) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="pay-button", data-testid="cart-item-remove").
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.currency_formatting: Always display prices in INR format with symbol ₹ (e.g., ₹2,499, ₹4,999).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion_and_animation: Keep subtle transitions between 150ms and 250ms (e.g. transition-colors duration-200). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons_and_media: Use Lucide-react icons cleanly. Absolutely NO emoji characters as icons or titles.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility_and_contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards over #FAF6F5 and #FFFFFF backgrounds with dark brown #5C2018 text.
